cards.answer: Zeri is a mobile marksman who repeatedly fires Burst Fire and can dash across terrain. Her build focus is AD, with physical damage from Burst Fire and magic damage from charged attacks; her ultimate rewards continued champion hits with movement speed.
cards.counterplay: Use minions to obstruct her shots before she gains piercing, and break contact during her ultimate.

cards.answer: Burst Fire shoots directional rounds that each deal physical damage to the first enemy hit. It counts as a basic attack, can critically strike and applies on-hit effects. Attack speed makes it fire more frequently, and silence does not disable it.
cards.counterplay: Use minions to obstruct unempowered shots and sidestep her firing direction; avoid relying on silence to stop her shots.

cards.answer: Spark Surge dashes and can carry Zeri across terrain. Afterwards, Burst Fire temporarily pierces enemies and deals bonus magic damage to the first target hit. Charged attacks and Burst Fire hits reduce Spark Surge's cooldown, with greater reduction from Burst Fire critical strikes.
cards.counterplay: Account for routes across terrain when chasing, and avoid lining up behind allies after her dash.

cards.answer: Lightning Crash deals magic damage around Zeri; hitting an enemy champion makes her Overcharged. Overcharged grants attack speed and movement speed, and makes Burst Fire faster with chain lightning that deals physical damage. Ability and charged-attack hits on champions extend Overcharged and build temporary movement-speed stacks.
cards.counterplay: Break contact to let her empowerment expire, and spread away from allies to limit chain lightning.
